tasks.title: Create a client project

tasks.title: Log time
tasks.prompt: Log in to my Clockify account and log 1 hour 30 minutes for today on the Acme Website Redesign project with the description Homepage wireframes.

tasks.title: Check weekly hours
tasks.prompt: Log in to my Clockify account and find a report showing how many hours I tracked this week and on which project.

tasks.prompt: Log in to my Dynalist account and create a new document called Website Redesign Plan.

tasks.title: Outline the plan
tasks.prompt: Log in to my Dynalist account and in the Website Redesign Plan document add three items: Research, Wireframes, and Launch, with Homepage sketch indented under Wireframes.

tasks.title: Check off an item
tasks.prompt: Log in to my Dynalist account and check off the Research item in the Website Redesign Plan document so it shows as completed.

I typed Website Redesign Plan there and pressed Enter, but I reloaded about 2 s later and the name was back to Untitled: the change had not synced yet and nothing warned me. I renamed it again from the big title, the corner showed "Sync now" (unsynced) until I clicked it, then "Synced". After a reload the document is called Website Redesign Plan in the sidebar and the title. Friction: reloading quietly drops unsynced edits; the sync state is a small grey word in the top corner.
